sentences.en: The brain was not like the liver or the lungs.
sentences.zh: 大脑不像肝脏或肺那样工作。

sentences.en: Make sure you get twenty rat livers for this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 确保今天下午准备二十只老鼠的肝脏。

sentences.en: This Bavarian Leberkäse doesn't contain any cheese nor liver.
sentences.zh: 这种巴伐利亚莱伯凯斯里既没有奶酪也没有肝脏。

senses.zh: 肝脏,（食用）肝,深赤褐色,生活者adj.肝味的,深赤褐色的
